rules.statement: A deed executed by a Muhammadan husband in favour of his wife after the consummation of the marriage for Maggar should be stamped under item 30 (6) of the Stamp Amendment Ordinance, 1919.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that the document should be stamped under item 30 (6) of Stamp Amendment Ordinance, 1919."
